answer.explanation: The live CompressionFunction config is MemorySize 128 MB and Timeout 3 s, but the IaC template specifies 1024 MB and 60 s. The function was modified at 00:25:00Z, right at the window start, and no commit touches its settings. In the window, about 40 invocations ended with Status: timeout at exactly 3000 ms, while Max Memory Used stayed around 91-98 MB, so the problem is the timeout (and the memory setting), not code or IAM. The CRUD TABLE_NAME commits and the thumbnailer/uploader commits are outside this window and do not match the affected function.
